description: Get one verified stablecoin/RWA market metric ($0.01 USDC per call). First call (no payment_signature) returns the payment challenge; pay the exact USDC on Solana, then call again with payment_signature.

name.description: Metric name, e.g. stablecoin_market_cap, rwa_total_value, agent_x402_volume_usd, top_yield_opportunities

payment_signature.description: Optional. Omit on the first call to receive the payment challenge. After sending the exact USDC amount on Solana mainnet to the pay_to wallet, call again with this set to the Solana transaction signature of your payment.

name: get_metric
